descriptionChirho: The proper noun אִמֵּר (Immer), referring to a priestly family or its ancestral head, appearing in Ezra 2:37, Nehemiah 7:40, 11:13, 1 Chronicles 9:12, 24:14, Jeremiah 20:1, and Ezra 2:59/Nehemiah 7:61 (a place name). All 10 occurrences across languages consistently render this as the same proper name: eng 'Immer', spa 'Imer', hin 'इम्मेर', arb 'إِمَّيرَ/إِمِّيرَ', kor '임멜/임메르', swa 'Imeri'. The two clusters differ only in prefixed prepositions (bare name or waw-conjunction vs. lamed-preposition), which are grammatical particles not affecting the referent identity.
